ideas.what: Truncated simplicial-type object with S_n actions (symmetric simplicial set / FinSet-indexed object) in degrees ≤ 2, presented by generators and relations
ideas.modern_name: symmetric simplicial sets; presheaves on finite nonempty sets (truncated)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck's own 'symmetric' variants in Pursuing Stacks; Grandis; others
ideas.where_published: Pursuing Stacks discusses variants of simplicial-type test categories, but this exact presentation is not known there

ideas.what: Reduction to the case E_0 = point: E_1 and E_2 become pointed and the S_n actions preserve the points; the data reduce to E_1 ⇄ E_2 with five relations
ideas.modern_name: one-object (reduced) symmetric simplicial set, pointed presentation

deep.surprise_reason: Routine combinatorial bookkeeping: relations between permutations, projections and degeneracies in a low-dimensional symmetric simplicial-type structure. Nothing here goes beyond standard material.
